facts.text: 2.74-Meter High-Gain Antenna was deployed at Interstellar Trajectory — Aldebaran & Aquila during Pioneer 10 & 11 in 1972.
2.74-meter parabolic aluminum dish reflector with a central tripod feed horn, oriented continuously toward Earth to send faint radio whispers across billions of miles.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Transmitted science data from beyond 80 AU (12 billion km), maintaining lock with the Deep Space Network for over 30 years.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Interstellar Trajectory — Aldebaran & Aquila.
Humanity's first long-distance radio link from the outer boundaries of our solar neighborhood.
